name: ib
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(-86,1.7,14),new T.Vector3(0,0,1));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true);const o=h.slice(0,3).map(x=>{const g=x.object.geometry;g.computeBoundingBox();const bb=g.boundingBox;return {n:x.object.name,d:+x.distance.toFixed(2),size:[+(bb.max.x-bb.min.x).toFixed(2),+(bb.max.y-bb.min.y).toFixed(2),+(bb.max.z-bb.min.z).toFixed(2)],world:[x.object.getWorldPosition(new T.Vector3()).toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(2))]};});return JSON.stringify(o)})()
